crossRefs.note: A certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, “Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak.”

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: A certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, “Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak.”
translations.bsb: When one of the men saw this, he told Joab, “I just saw Absalom hanging in an oak tree!”
translations.kjv: And a certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.
translations.asv: And a certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak.
